import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the memcpy function prototype
memcpy = gsl.memcpy
memcpy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint]
memcpy.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

# Function to copy data using memcpy
def copy_data(destaddr, srcaddr, length):
    dest_buffer = (ctypes.c_char * length).from_buffer(destaddr)
    src_buffer = (ctypes.c_char * length).from_buffer(srcaddr)
    memcpy(dest_buffer, src_buffer, length)
    return destaddr

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Basic copy
    src = bytearray(b'Hello World')
    dest = bytearray(len(src))
    copy_data(dest, src, len(src))
    assert dest == src, f"Test case 1 failed: {dest} != {src}"

    # Test case 2: Partial copy
    src = bytearray(b'Python ctypes')
    dest = bytearray(len(src))
    copy_data(dest, src, 6)
    assert dest[:6] == src[:6], f"Test case 2 failed: {dest[:6]} != {src[:6]}"

    # Test case 3: Zero length copy
    src = bytearray(b'No copy')
    dest = bytearray(len(src))
    copy_data(dest, src, 0)
    assert dest == bytearray(len(src)), f"Test case 3 failed: {dest} != {bytearray(len(src))}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
